respiratory-zhong-nan-shan.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering; recipient of the Medal of the Republic
respiratory-zhong-nan-shan.authority: China's leading figure in respiratory medicine; core founder of the National Clinical Research Center for Respiratory Diseases and the State Key Laboratory of Respiratory Disease; former President of the Chinese Medical Association; long-time architect of China's respiratory disease prevention strategy.
respiratory-zhong-nan-shan.focus: COPD, bronchial asthma, lung cancer, respiratory infectious diseases, lung transplantation and respiratory critical care.
respiratory-zhong-nan-shan.achievement: Led China's SARS response in 2003; served as head of the National Health Commission's high-level expert group in 2020 and confirmed person-to-person transmission of COVID-19; drove the development of China's respiratory infectious disease control system and lung transplantation techniques.
respiratory-zhong-nan-shan.honors: Medal of the Republic; National Science and Technology Progress Special Award (participant); National Advanced Worker; Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

respiratory-cao-bin.achievement: Led clinical and translational research on respiratory viral infections including COVID-19 and influenza, advancing severe-case early warning and antiviral treatment strategies.
respiratory-cao-bin.honors: Infection research platform of the National Clinical Research Center for Respiratory Diseases; leads National Key R&D Program projects on respiratory infections.

respiratory-xu-zuo-jun.achievement: Established a multidisciplinary care pathway for interstitial lung disease (ILD), promoting early recognition and standardised treatment.
respiratory-xu-zuo-jun.honors: Leads ILD registries and clinical research including idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

respiratory-bai-chun-xue.achievement: Proposed and popularised an internet-of-things model for early lung cancer screening and built an AI assessment system for pulmonary nodules.
respiratory-bai-chun-xue.honors: Early lung cancer screening programmes and multicentre AI research on pulmonary nodules.

respiratory-lai-ke-fang.achievement: Led the drafting of China's chronic cough diagnosis and treatment guideline and established dedicated chronic cough clinics.
respiratory-lai-ke-fang.honors: Research on chronic cough mechanisms and cough hypersensitivity syndrome.

respiratory-wang-chen.focus: Respiratory and critical care medicine, pulmonary embolism, respiratory support technology; principal lead of the National Clinical Research Center for Respiratory Diseases (Beijing).

respiratory-qu-jie-ming.focus: Respiratory infections, pulmonary infections and critical care.

respiratory-chen-rong-chang.focus: COPD, respiratory mechanics and non-invasive ventilation.

cardiology-ge-jun-bo.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Sciences
cardiology-ge-jun-bo.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; standing council member of the World Heart Federation; chairman of the China Cardiovascular Health Alliance; former chair of the Chinese Society of Cardiology; a leading figure in interventional cardiology in China.
cardiology-ge-jun-bo.focus: Complex coronary intervention, structural heart intervention (valvular disease and congenital heart disease), acute myocardial infarction care, and integrated management of complex cardiovascular disease.
cardiology-ge-jun-bo.achievement: Developed the internationally recognised transcatheter heart valve replacement approach known as the Hangzhou method, offering a minimally invasive option for elderly patients unfit for open-heart surgery; advanced the national chest pain centre system.
cardiology-ge-jun-bo.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award; National Innovation Award.

cardiology-hua-wei.achievement: Advanced pacing electrophysiology and CRT/ICD device therapy, leading several expert consensus documents on device treatment.
cardiology-hua-wei.honors: Multicentre research on device therapy for arrhythmias.

cardiology-zhou-yu-jie.achievement: Complex coronary intervention and transcatheter valve therapy; advanced circulatory support for high-risk PCI.
cardiology-zhou-yu-jie.honors: Research on optimised coronary intervention and structural heart disease.

cardiology-chen-shao-liang.achievement: Originated a two-stent technique for coronary bifurcation lesions (adopted in international guidelines); pioneered denervation therapy for pulmonary hypertension.
cardiology-chen-shao-liang.honors: Research on bifurcation lesion intervention and interventional treatment of pulmonary hypertension.

cardiology-huang-lan.achievement: Research on high-altitude heart disease and coronary care; established a prevention and treatment system for high-altitude cardiovascular disease.
cardiology-huang-lan.honors: National-level research projects on high-altitude heart disease.

cardiology-han-ya-ling.focus: Complex and critical coronary intervention, chronic total occlusion (CTO) lesions, antithrombotic therapy.

cardiology-gao-run-lin.focus: Coronary intervention, emergency management of acute myocardial infarction.

cardiology-ma-chang-sheng.focus: Catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation, arrhythmias.

cardiac-surgery-hu-sheng-shou.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
cardiac-surgery-hu-sheng-shou.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; director of the National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases; president of Fuwai Hospital; a leading figure in cardiovascular surgery and ventricular assist devices/artificial hearts in China.
cardiac-surgery-hu-sheng-shou.focus: Coronary surgery, valve surgery, congenital heart disease, end-stage heart failure with ventricular assist devices, heart transplantation.
cardiac-surgery-hu-sheng-shou.achievement: Led the development and clinical application of a domestically produced fully magnetically levitated artificial heart, advancing end-stage heart failure care and scaling up heart transplantation in China.
cardiac-surgery-hu-sheng-shou.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

cardiac-surgery-guo-ying-qiang.achievement: Innovations in transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) and mitral valve intervention.
cardiac-surgery-guo-ying-qiang.honors: Multicentre clinical research on structural heart intervention.

cardiac-surgery-zhao-qiang.achievement: Total-arterial grafting strategy for coronary bypass and minimally invasive coronary surgery.
cardiac-surgery-zhao-qiang.honors: Multicentre randomised controlled trials in coronary surgery.

cardiac-surgery-liu-sheng.achievement: Clinical application of heart transplantation and ventricular assist devices (artificial heart).
cardiac-surgery-liu-sheng.honors: Research on transplant immune tolerance and mechanical circulatory support.

cardiac-surgery-feng-wei.achievement: Coronary surgery and surgical ablation for atrial fibrillation.
cardiac-surgery-feng-wei.honors: Research on surgical treatment of atrial fibrillation and coronary revascularisation.

cardiac-surgery-sun-li-zhong.focus: Aortic aneurysm and dissection, complex cardiac surgery.

cardiac-surgery-zhuang-jian.focus: Congenital heart surgery, complex cardiac procedures.

cardiac-surgery-pan-xiang-bin.focus: Structural heart intervention, transcatheter valve therapy.

neurosurgery-zhou-liang-fu.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
neurosurgery-zhou-liang-fu.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; honorary chair of the Chinese Neurosurgical Society; one of the pioneers of minimally invasive and microsurgery in Chinese neurosurgery.
neurosurgery-zhou-liang-fu.focus: Central nervous system tumours, cerebrovascular disease, congenital conditions, craniocerebral trauma; minimally invasive, navigated and microsurgery.
neurosurgery-zhou-liang-fu.achievement: Helped establish Huashan Hospital's neurosurgery department as a world-class centre, with internationally advanced outcomes in complex procedures for cerebral aneurysms, skull base tumours and vascular malformations.
neurosurgery-zhou-liang-fu.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award; Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

neurosurgery-bo-bo.achievement: Innovative microsurgical approaches to skull base tumours (petroclival, cavernous sinus and jugular foramen regions).
neurosurgery-bo-bo.honors: Research on surgical treatment of skull base tumours and skull base anatomy.

neurosurgery-chen-xiao-lei.achievement: Pioneered workflows combining intraoperative MRI with functional neuronavigation and endoscopic treatment of hypertensive intracerebral haemorrhage.
neurosurgery-chen-xiao-lei.honors: Research on neuroendoscopy and intraoperative image navigation.

neurosurgery-jian-feng-zeng.achievement: Spinal neurosurgery: minimally invasive treatment of cervical spondylosis and spinal cord tumours.
neurosurgery-jian-feng-zeng.honors: Research on minimally invasive surgery for spinal and spinal cord disease.

neurosurgery-jiang-rong-cai.achievement: Statin therapy for chronic subdural haematoma with a reported cure rate of about 84%.
neurosurgery-jiang-rong-cai.honors: Multicentre research on pharmacotherapy for chronic subdural haematoma.

neurosurgery-ling-feng.focus: Brain and spinal vascular disease, cervical spondylosis.

neurology-cui-li-ying.title: Chief physician, professor, doctoral supervisor
neurology-cui-li-ying.authority: Director of neurology at Peking Union Medical College Hospital; former chair of the Chinese Society of Neurology; an authority on neuromuscular disease and electrophysiology in China.
neurology-cui-li-ying.focus: Neuromuscular disease, EMG and neuroelectrophysiology, motor neuron disease, peripheral neuropathy, Parkinson's disease and cerebrovascular disease.
neurology-cui-li-ying.achievement: Led the establishment of national neuroelectrophysiology diagnostic standards and is a national leader in the diagnosis and treatment of rare neuromuscular diseases such as ALS.
neurology-cui-li-ying.honors: Chinese Medical Science and Technology Award; National Outstanding Science and Technology Worker.

neurology-chen-sheng-di.achievement: Research on early diagnosis of Parkinson's disease and movement disorders.
neurology-chen-sheng-di.honors: National clinical research cohort for Parkinson's disease.

neurology-fan-dong-sheng.achievement: ALS registry system and genetic diagnosis.

neurology-ceng-jin-sheng.achievement: Acute-phase management and secondary prevention of cerebrovascular disease.
neurology-ceng-jin-sheng.honors: National-level research projects on stroke prevention and treatment.

neurology-xu-yun.achievement: Cerebral small vessel disease and post-stroke cognitive impairment.
neurology-xu-yun.honors: Cohort research on cerebral small vessel disease.

neurology-wang-yong-jun.focus: Cerebrovascular disease, stroke centre systems and the CHANCE trial programme.

orthopedics-qiu-gui-xing.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
orthopedics-qiu-gui-xing.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; former chair of the Chinese Orthopaedic Association; an authority on spine surgery and spinal deformity correction in China.
orthopedics-qiu-gui-xing.focus: Scoliosis and spinal deformity, degenerative spinal disease, joint replacement, complex orthopaedic surgery.
orthopedics-qiu-gui-xing.achievement: Established the PUMC classification for scoliosis, widely adopted internationally, and standardised spinal deformity correction surgery in China.
orthopedics-qiu-gui-xing.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

orthopedics-zhang-ying-ze.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
orthopedics-zhang-ying-ze.achievement: Proposed the concept of internal bone medicine and a minimally invasive fracture treatment system; invented minimally invasive fixation for pelvic fractures.
orthopedics-zhang-ying-ze.honors: Minimally invasive fracture treatment and internal bone medicine research.

orthopedics-wang-kun-zheng.achievement: Joint replacement and hip- and knee-preserving techniques.
orthopedics-wang-kun-zheng.honors: Clinical and prosthesis research in joint replacement.

orthopedics-zhou-dong-sheng.achievement: Pelvic and acetabular fractures and severe polytrauma care.
orthopedics-zhou-dong-sheng.honors: Research on minimally invasive pelvic fracture fixation.

orthopedics-qu-tie-bing.achievement: Complex joint replacement and revision, treatment of joint infection.
orthopedics-qu-tie-bing.honors: Research on joint revision and infection prevention.

orthopedics-tang-pei-fu.focus: Orthopaedic trauma, reconstruction after severe polytrauma.

orthopedics-tian-wei.focus: Spine surgery, navigation-assisted surgery, upper cervical deformity.

oncology-xu-rui-hua.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
oncology-xu-rui-hua.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; president of Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center; a leader in precision diagnosis and immunotherapy of gastrointestinal cancers in China.
oncology-xu-rui-hua.focus: Gastrointestinal cancers (colorectal, gastric, oesophageal), tumour immunotherapy and targeted therapy, integrated treatment of advanced cancer.
oncology-xu-rui-hua.achievement: Led multiple international multicentre trials that brought immunotherapy and precision subtyping for colorectal and gastric cancer into international guidelines.
oncology-xu-rui-hua.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

oncology-shen-lin.achievement: Clinical research on precision and immunotherapy for gastrointestinal cancers.
oncology-shen-lin.honors: Multicentre clinical research on gastric and oesophageal cancer.

oncology-qin-shu-kui.achievement: Systemic therapy and molecular targeted research in liver cancer.
oncology-qin-shu-kui.honors: Liver cancer clinical trial collaborative group.

oncology-guo-jun.achievement: Immunotherapy and targeted therapy for melanoma.
oncology-guo-jun.honors: Translational and clinical research in melanoma.

oncology-wu-ling-ying.achievement: Radiotherapy and integrated treatment for gynaecological cancers.
oncology-wu-ling-ying.honors: Clinical research on cervical and ovarian cancer.
